goal: Show declared circular footprints at actual committed centers, with existing numeric pair results and complete study custody.

implementation.inputs: Existing admitted assessment.practice.results attempts and ID-matched declared radii. No target, tolerance, translation or hypothetical coordinates.
implementation.geometry: Uniform physical-mm viewBox containing full footprints. Source-order numeric keys precede filtering; an ordered textual key retains missing marks and exact recorded values. Coincident centers retain every circle and receive a shared-center explanation. Zero-radius markers are annotations.
implementation.withholding: No SVG, key or geometric description before commitment; empty committed trials remain a distinct missing-placement state. Successful comparison replacement clears prior diagram content.
implementation.scoring: Existing pair table remains authoritative; no core, event, score or export format change.

baseline.expectedFailure: Committed feature review must offer a declared-footprint view
baseline.meaning: The real center-pass/gap-fail study reaches feature review, whose maintained baseline has no diagram.

comparisons.mixed: Actual centers (22,50),(38,50), declared radii 5, produce the unchanged table's gap 6 against required 10 while original center tolerances pass.
comparisons.minimum: Actual 1x1 sheet; source order zero/missing/circle and reversed radius declarations. Centers (0.5,0.5), radii 0 and 0.25, missing middle key 2. Signed observed gap -0.25 and two incomplete pairs preserved. Empty commitment performed through the real enabled UI.
comparisons.extreme: Actual 1x10000 sheet; centers (0.25,1),(0.75,9999), radii 10000 and 3. Independent footprint bounds [-9999.75,10000.25,-9999,10002] include the smaller feature's extension beyond the largest.
comparisons.capacity: Thirty actual zero-radius placements across a 1x1 sheet. All source keys retained; two-digit key 30 contained at 390px. Dense labels overlap, while the complete textual key remains readable.
comparisons.custody: Exact completed raw and complete-study downloads before/after viewing and resizing. Failed imports retain the current diagram; different-ID committed replacement changes geometry, and uncommitted replacement removes it.

visualReview.executor: Lead inspected actual desktop and 390px screenshots through Renpo.
visualReview.observed: Sparse circles, numeric keys and complete footprints are readable. Missing/coincident identities and extreme-radius values remain explicit. Long literal label text wraps safely. Dense inline labels can overlap; no claim of universal plot-label readability.

review.validation: Retained validation independently reviewed receiving design and root-executed terminal evidence. This is not independent execution.
